title: Replace failed items, then recheck coverage
statement: Take every item a check or filter fails out of what learners see and replace it, not just exclude it from scoring, then recheck skill and format coverage.
example: One course went out with 231 of 772 items it had classed as answerable without the text still live.
detail: An adversarial review of the Grade 5 submission found 231/772 items (29.9%) classified as known-leaky, excluded from the gate instruments but not removed from the live course (`grade3-reading/ti-courseplans/docs/redteam-sources/g5-reading-redteam-round1-2026-07-06.md`, line 17), and the course formula drew the lesson that a leaky item awards progress for not reading (`grade3-reading/ti-courseplans/docs/course-formula-agents.md`, line 233). The same review found all 20 two-part evidence items in the excluded bucket, so six-format coverage quietly became five-format on the certified core (the review, line 27). An excluded item still rewards skipping the work, and a filter that is right item by item can drop a whole skill or format.
against: the review allowed one way out that the package did not demonstrate: the items confined to non-gating slots (`ti-courseplans-audit/docs/redteam-sources/g5-reading-redteam-round1-2026-07-06.md`). raw choice items leaked, but choice items built to need the passage passed: a pilot converted 20/27 and a later lane 142/234, so the skew toward technology-enhanced formats can be designed out (`grade3-reading/knowledge_bot/knowledge/kb-0089-parent-claude-sessions-worklog-2026-07-09.qmd`). A later run found: Two later courses took the way out that this record's review allowed but did not see demonstrated: a Grade 8 course confined its leaky formats to a 43-item non-gating practice lane for format exposure, all flagged gating:false with no audit errors, and a Grade 7 audit counted no practice item leaking into a gate. No source measures whether practising on leaky items helps or harms, so whether a failed item may stay in front of learners as flagged practice is open (`incept-package-hub/course-packages/courses/g8-reading/review/evidence/case-for-review.md`). A later run found counter-evidence (`grade3-reading/edullm-review-hub/course-packages/courses/g8-reading/review/evidence/case-for-review.md`). A later run found counter-evidence (`incept-package-hub/course-packages/courses/g8-reading/review/evidence/case-for-review.md`).
